assembly_sequence: Finish the closed base. Introduce the U into the isolated right arm. Mount each 165-part arm with side beam81 and pin84 deferred, jaws closed and head roll0. Seat arms in R, L, F, B order and restore each side pin followed by its beam. Before installing the cube, support or tray, hold the lever at42.4mm and configure each arm separately: closed-jaw roll0 to50 degrees, then open the jaws to25 degrees. Continue support assembly afterward. See the geometry report for coordinates and scope.
